title: Desktop and mobile runtime
when: Before creating or changing a plugin; platform limits, lifecycle, network and capability checks.

title: Touch-first interface design
when: Any generated interface: narrow screens, touch, keyboard, safe areas and accessibility.

title: Desktop and pane interface design
when: Any generated interface: narrow panes, keyboard, focus, themes and multiple windows.

title: Notes as structured records
when: Persisting user data, relationships, Properties, Bases, synchronization or schema migrations.

title: Hexagonal architecture and pragmatic DDD
when: Before building a plugin: domain vocabulary, invariants, use cases and adapters.

title: Verify the user's actual workflow
when: Before claiming completion; test behavior, layout, persistence, errors and both platforms.
